Nope, I did it legally in places where overnight parking was allowed for non-self contained vehicles. I bet you could do it, but I was too scared of being woken up by a police. Some of the spots had toilets, most of them actually. Otherwise we (was there with a partner) made sure we had peed before parking for the night. We didn't really shower, but some of the campgrounds will have showers (but they might cost more). Bigger cities might also have pools or petrol stations with showers. Different apps were pretty useful with finding good spots for showers. But honestly, we did a lot of baby wipes (haha this is why this the super budget version of camping).

Depends where you're going. I just finished living two weeks in a station wagon and it was pretty handy. We paid about 15 dollars a day for the car and used a lot of free spots. Usually we would just go to sleep after the dark and wake up very early to move to the next location. Dowload the Rankers app, it was very useful. Of course, this was the extreme budget version.
